name: trackiq-amazon-category-priority-keywords
title: TrackIQ: Amazon Category Priority Keywords
summary: Groups an Amazon catalogue into product categories, then picks the 25 search terms per category worth tracking organic rank on — each with weekly volume, estimated monthly revenue, impression share, and whether the rank tracker already covers it.

delivery.note: in-chat always works and is the fallback. file needs a filesystem, n8n needs network, slack and email need their tool connected. Outward sends confirm first.

fallback: Works from a Brand Analytics Search Query Performance export plus revenue and orders by ASIN when the TrackIQ MCP is not connected. Everything except the rank-tracker column is reproducible.
